payment.how_it_works: A secure payment link is sent through the existing sales and accounting path. Setup starts when the paid confirmation event (start_payment_received) is recorded, together with agreement_signed, per wiring contract section 3.3. No amounts are stored in this package.

repository.creation_path: The provisioning run creates the repository through the GitHub Provisioning connector (custom.github-provisioning, verified live 2026-11-05) and reads it back. If that credential is expired or unavailable, creation becomes a certified team fulfillment step under the Install Fulfillment Training model, and this package is pushed the moment the repo exists. This record stays false until a creation is verified by read back.
